title: [v0.92.1][DEC-01] Runtime v2/v3 authority separation
body:
## Outcome

Produce one independently owned Runtime v2 and Runtime v3 authority topology with executable migration and rollback.

## Primary deliverable

One independently owned Runtime v2 and Runtime v3 source and authority topology with an executable migration and rollback contract.

## Verification result

Source and reverse-reference censuses, compatibility proof, rollback, and migration checks pass with Runtime v4 excluded.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted v2-v3 authority topology; migration and rollback checks are evidence inputs.

## Dependencies

- WP-01: #480

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every source and reverse reference has one owner and disposition
- [ ] Supported behavior has compatibility proof
- [ ] Rollback and migration are executable
- [ ] Runtime v4 remains excluded

## Owned paths

- `adl/src/runtime_v2/**`
- `adl-runtime/**`
- `adl-runtime-kernel/**`
- `docs/runtime/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/runtime-decoupling/**`

## PVF lanes

- `source-denominator`
- `reverse-reference-census`
- `compatibility`
- `rollback`
- `migration`

## Stop conditions

- A supported consumer is unclassified
- Either runtime silently acquires the other runtime's authority
- Runtime v4 scope is required

## Non-goals

- Runtime v4 implementation
- Behavior deletion without proof
